overview_description.description: Saatvy provides a personalized Ayurvedic wellness platform for individuals managing chronic health conditions. The company offers online access to vetted Ayurvedic practitioners who design customized wellness programs targeting issues such as gut disorders, sleep problems, diabetes, arthritis, allergies, and postpartum thyroiditis. Its platform combines traditional Ayurveda practices with tailored nutrition plans, yoga routines, stress management guidance, and natural supplement tracking. Users share health information through the digital interface, and practitioners use these inputs to create and adjust individualized care plans. Saatvy focuses on addressing underlying causes of long-term conditions rather than only treating surface symptoms. The service is aimed at consumers seeking natural and holistic approaches alongside or outside conventional medical care.
